args.title: Add TSV export option for reports
args.body: The current implementation of report exports only supports CSV and XLSX formats. This change proposes an additional export option for tab-separated values (TSV), which is essential for our warehouse loader that exclusively accepts tab-delimited files. The TSV format will be included as an alternative to the existing CSV and XLSX formats. This will prevent potential issues arising from commas in transaction descriptions when converting from CSV to TSV manually.
